mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pd.id AS skuId, pd.images_url, pd.sku_no, pc.country, pc.country_name as countryName, pc.to_declare_price as toDeclarePrice, pc.to_currency as toCurrency, pc.to_currency_symbol as toCurrencySymbol, pc.customs_code, pc.tax_rate, pc.type FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_customs pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.product_id = #{productId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pc.update_time

SELECT pc.id, pd.id AS skuId, pd.images_url, pd.sku_no, pc.country, pc.country_name as countryName, pc.to_declare_price as toDeclarePrice, pc.to_currency as toCurrency, pc.to_currency_symbol as toCurrencySymbol, pc.customs_code, pc.tax_rate, pc.type FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_customs pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.id = #{skuId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pd.id desc

SELECT pc.ID AS ID, pc.create_user_id AS createUserId, pc.create_user_name AS createUserName, pc.create_time AS createTime, pc.update_user_id AS updateUserId, pc.update_user_name AS updateUserName, pc.update_time AS updateTime, pc.VERSION AS VERSION, pc.is_deleted AS isDeleted, pd.ID AS skuId, pd.sku_no AS skuNo, pd.images_url AS imagesUrl, pl.declare_chinese_name AS declareChineseName, pl.customs_code AS chinaCustomsCode, pc.country AS country, pc.to_declare_price AS toDeclarePrice, pc.to_currency AS toCurrency, pc.to_currency_symbol AS toCurrencySymbol, pc.customs_code AS destinationCustomsCode, pc.tax_rate as taxRate, pc.destination_vat_rate as destinationVatRate, pc.destination_additional_duty_rate as destinationAdditionalDutyRate, pc.destination_anti_dumping_duty_rate as destinationAntiDumpingDutyRate, pc.destination_other_tax_rate as destinationOtherTaxRate, pc.TYPE, pc.destination_customs_en_name as destinationCustomsEnName, pl.declare_model as declareModel, pl.declare_element as declareElement FROM product_customs pc LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pc.sku_id = pd.ID AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.ID = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_logistics pl ON pl.sku_id = pc.sku_id AND pl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pc.is_deleted = FALSE and pc.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY pc.sku_id,pc.id DESC
